label: MSA post analysis, single proposal (CS)
_note: One sheet per network plus a 'TOTAL' sheet. Estimated-vs-delivered blocks are labelled EST when the deal is unguaranteed and GTD when it is guaranteed; that word is captured as gtd_basis because it decides whether a shortfall is a liability. The 'PROP TO DATE' block below the main table is prior-quarter history and is skipped to avoid double counting.
_note_anchors: Anchors are scanned across the first rows rather than pinned to a cell reference: these reports are visually centered, so the title lands in D2 in one file and elsewhere in another, and the label block sits in column B.
